company.name: Vendease
company.shortDescription: Vendease is a marketplace that lets restaurants in Africa order directly from farms and food manufacturers.
company.description:
VendEase is an online marketplace that lets restaurants in Africa, order supplies directly from farms and food manufacturers. Using the platform, food service business owners and managers can digitize, track, and automate their procurement and inventory management processes. It also provides businesses with analytics to improve profitability and eliminate waste.

The company was founded in 2020 and is based in Lagos, Nigeria.
